reverse_edges.Tempus AI -> Recursion: Tempus licenses de-identified multimodal oncology data to Recursion (the existing Recursion -> Tempus AI edge is the TxFM model licence flowing the other way)

players.product: multimodal clinical data, diagnostics, and AI applications

connects_to.relationship: licenses de-identified multimodal oncology data and access to its clinical / molecular database to Recursion

contracts.signal: Recursion (customer for Tempus data): Under a November 2023 Master Agreement, Tempus provides certain services and licenses data to Recursion, including a limited right to access its proprietary database of de-identified clinical and molecular data for certain therapeutic product development purposes. Recursion pays an initial license fee of $22 million and an annual license fee throughout the term, together totaling up to $160 million; the term continues through November 3, 2028, and Recursion may terminate for convenience after three years upon 90 days prior notice, subject to an early termination fee. Fees are payable in cash or Recursion Class A common stock at Recursion's option; Tempus received $32.0 million and $22.0 million in Recursion shares as payment of accounts receivable in 2025 and 2024.
contracts.value: up to $160 million in total (initial license fee $22 million); $32.0 million received in Recursion shares in 2025
